name: lemo
description: Lemody (lemodysounds.online) — sing along, see your pitch, get better. A Wiecodes product.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix web install && npm run setup:analyzer
scripts.setup:analyzer: cd analyzer && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && cp -n .env.example .env || true
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,analyzer -c yellow,gray "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm run analyzer"
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && npm run test:analyzer
